name: Prangon
what: Bangladeshi schools build and publish their own website from an Android app, in the government (DSHE) format or a photo-led template, then pay yearly or monthly by bKash, Nagad or bank.
hard_part: Every school gets a live subdomain under one wildcard certificate renewed through Route 53 DNS-01, while custom domains use on-demand TLS gated by an ask endpoint that only approves published, verified domains. Domain verification queries the authoritative nameservers directly to avoid stale DNS.
demo_note: four demo school sites, e.g. kolkakoli-kg.prangon.dcampusbd.com; demo app logins reset nightly
facts: 4 templates, including the government Promito format with the 10 DSHE menus
56 end-to-end API and site checks plus 86 admin-panel checks
11-item DSHE checklist, each item deep-linked to its editor
Custom domain verified end to end with a Let's Encrypt certificate in about 7 s
